title: Piece Breve
identity: René Duclos's Pièce brève is an E-flat alto saxophone and piano work, Leduc AL20943 (1951). The Philharmonie guide describes three connected sections: melodic Allegretto in 6/8, Allegretto scherzando in 9/8, then a return to Allegretto; it lists low C to high E, a 3-minute duration, and fifth-year use in its conservatory sequence. The pitch convention for the range is unspecified.

evidence.claim: Guide entry gives instrumentation, 1951, 3 minutes, three connected sections in 6/8 and 9/8 with a tempo return, range low C to high E (pitch convention unspecified), and fifth-year placement.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, 10 ans avec le saxophone

evidence.claim: IMSLP publicly lists a complete score and separate E-flat saxophone part. Direct retrieval of both listed PDF paths returned an HTML verification page instead of notation.
Luxembourg government syllabus lists the piece in Division inférieure, 1ère mention.
Quebec conservatory syllabus includes the piece in its preconservatory repertoire.

review_focus: Inference from guide evidence: review the linked 6/8 to 9/8 movement into scherzando and return, with the full range checked in the transposed E-flat part. Exact pitch convention remains unknown.
collection_flag: Pedagogical repertoire documented in government and conservatory syllabi.
